name: tbd/termplot
description: PHP library for Kitty graphics — CLI charting and terminal dashboards

suggest.ext-gd: Optional; enables LineChart/BarChart PNG rendering on the Kitty path.
suggest.ext-zlib: Optional; enables Kitty o=z zlib compression of payloads.
suggest.ext-posix: Optional; posix_isatty fallback for TTY detection.

termplot.note: Packagist vendor is TBD. This package MUST NOT be published to Packagist.
